default.scope: Unqualified image; interpreter execution with dynamic ELF loading, multi-process trees with scheduled networking and no practical instruction limit (UINT64_MAX steps). Loading does not establish application compatibility.

native.scope: Unqualified image; native ARM64 execution under Hypervisor.framework (no guest kernel), Linux syscalls served by the runtime, threads on parallel vCPUs. Loading does not establish application compatibility.

images.scope: Prepared Redis 7.4.2 preset: native ARM64 execution under Hypervisor.framework, private writable data, loopback TCP. Experimental.
